extracted.name: Fried Cabbage and Bacon
extracted.description: Cabbage and onions are fried in bacon grease and served with crispy bacon and a splash of cider vinegar for a tasty and tangy side dish.
ingredient_lines: 6 cups cabbage, cut into thin wedges
instruction_lines: Place bacon in a large, deep skillet. Cook over medium-high heat until evenly brown. Remove bacon, and set aside.

Cook onion in the hot bacon grease until tender. Add cabbage, and stir in water, sugar, salt, and pepper. Cook until cabbage wilts, about 15 minutes. Stir in bacon. Splash with vinegar before serving.
